recent_en: NTPM held its 30th AGM on 28 September 2026, where all resolutions were passed by poll, and released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 31 July 2026 on the same day. The company issued its 2026 Annual Report in late August and circulated a shareholder circular on renewing the existing shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions (RRPT).
notable_en: The 30th AGM was held on 28 September 2026 and all resolutions were passed.
Proposed renewal of the existing shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions (RRPT) was tabled at the AGM.
